header.title: Hunting Job
header.description: Welcome to the Hunting, You can start a hunt from here and check out the missions. Good luck!

steps.information: Press the indicated key to learn what you need to do. Press for more details.

details.step1: Go to the hunting area and take your weapons from the vehicle. Use the [Target] key,
details.step2: Kill anilmals and Skin the animals with [TARGET] ( If there is a mission, it will proceed ),
details.step3: Go to the area where you started your job, look at the NPC with [TARGET], and click the “Sell animal parts” option to sell them.
